source: CMA-ES over 8 keyframes per leg at 1 Hz on the look stance (printed build, bare print, action_to_rad 1.3), scored on turn rate (up to 20 deg/s) minus 8 deg/s per cm/s of net travel, over the nominal and 3 random bodies: spins counter-clockwise about 24 deg/s on the nominal body travelling 0.4 cm/s (the first look spin: 12 deg/s, 2.0 cm/s); legs swapped, it spins clockwise
